```{r load_data, cache=TRUE, dependson=c("config")}
taxon_color <- load__taxon_color()

stdb <- load__Stdb()
wtdb <- load__Wtdb()
genome_taxonomy <- load__genome_taxonomy(stdb, wtdb)

genome_rltabd <-
  stringr::str_glue("Wtdb.relative_abundance.tsv") %>%
  file_path$file_path$results(.) %>%
  as.character() %>%
  get_relative_abundance(genome_taxonomy) %>%
  mutate(
    Taxa_label = sapply(taxon.split(get("Taxonomy"), 1, 7), get_taxon_color)
  )

genomeko <- load__genomeko()

#' gene_ko_tpm <- load__gene_ko_tpm()

key_genes <- load__key_genes()
pathway_col <- set__pathway_col(key_genes$Pathway)
```

```{r the most abundant clades}
focus_clades <- c(

```

```{r the most abundant clades}
annotation_class <-
  genome_rltabd %>%
  mutate(name = taxon.split(get("Taxonomy"), 1, 3)) %>%
  get_taxon_group("name") %>%
  column_to_rownames("name")

classlocko_pct <-
  wtdb %>%
  mutate(Genome = gsub(".fa$", "", get("Genome"))) %>%
  .[.$Genome %in% colnames(genomeko), ] %>%
  with(
    split(
      genomeko[, get("Genome")] %>% t() %>% data.frame(),
      get("Taxonomy") %>% taxon.split(1, 3)
    )
  ) %>%
  lapply(
    . %>% apply(
      2,
      . %>%
        {
          sum(. > 0) / length(.)
        }
    )
  ) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "Class") %>%
  column_to_rownames("Class")
```

## test example randomforest
```{r load data}
# OTU丰度预测植物年龄
data <- read.table("lc_study_mapping_file.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
raw_otu <- read.table("lc_study_otu_table.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t") %>%
  `rownames<-`(.[, length(.)]) %>%
  .[, -length(.)]
dim(data)
dim(raw_otu)

otu <- raw_otu %>%
  .[1:1000, ] %>%
  t() %>%
  .[data$SampleID[data$Compartment == "Endosphere"], ]

dim(otu)
otu_group <- data.frame(
  otu,
  groups = data[data$Compartment == "Endosphere", "Age"]
)
dim(otu_group)
```

```{r do estimation}
set.seed(1)

select_train <- dim(otu_group)[1] %>% sample(. * 0.7)
otu_train <- otu_group[select_train, ]
otu_test <- otu_group[-select_train, ]
# randomForest
#' library(randomForest)

otu_train_forest <- randomForest::randomForest(
  formula("groups ~ ."),
  data = otu_train, importance = TRUE
)
otu_train_forest %>%
  {
    print(.)
    # 可以解释时间变化的75.02%
    print(paste("可以解释时间变化的", .$rsq %>% .[length(.)]))

    otu_train_forest %>%
      {
        plot(.$predicted, otu_train$groups, main = "")
        abline(1, 1)
      }
  }

otu_train_forest %>%
  {
    plot(predict(., otu_train), otu_train$groups, main = "", col = "blue")
    points(predict(., otu_test), otu_test$groups, col = "red")
    abline(1, 1)
  }
```

```{r}
# OTUs
otu_train_forest %>%
  {
    randomForest::varImpPlot(
      .,
      n.var = min(50, nrow(.$importance)),
      main = "Top 50 - variable importance"
    )
  }

# Mean Decrease Accuracy
otu_train_forest$importance %>%
  {
    print(sum(.[, 1]))
    importance_top50 <- .[order(.[, "%IncMSE"], decreasing = TRUE), ] %>%
      .[1:50, "%IncMSE"]
    sum(importance_top50) / sum(.[, 1]) * 100
  }
# 前50个OTU可以解释所有OTU的95.55%
```

```{r otu_train_cv}
set.seed(1)
otu_train_cv_raw <- replicate(
  5,
  randomForest::rfcv(
    otu_train[-ncol(otu_train)], otu_train$group, cv.fold = 10, step = 1.5
  ),
  simplify = FALSE
)
length(otu_train_cv_raw)

#
otu_train_cv <- data.frame(sapply(otu_train_cv_raw, "[[", "error.cv")) %>%
  mutate(otus = as.numeric(rownames(.))) %>%
  pivot_longer(!"otus", names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

p <- ggplot(otu_train_cv, aes_string(x = "otus", y = "value")) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, method = "glm", formula = y ~ splines::ns(x, 6)) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = "transparent")
  ) +
  labs(title = "", x = "Number of OTUs", y = "Cross-validation error") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 50)
p
```
